inference_path: Official Python Decider reference path, fast=False, one request at a time, no KV cache, no generation.
task: Same twelve real target segments with full-review attribution context; calm only; unchanged v0.5 evidence definitions.
temperature: Use publisher decision_config temperature exactly once; retain raw pre-temperature readout logits and T=1 distributions separately. Do not fit an emotion-specific temperature from these twelve cases.
factors: Native criteria reordering jointly changes option positions and their internal A-D code assignments. This is not Gemma's isolated fixed-position letter-assignment factor. Four cyclic orders, not all 24 permutations.
repeatability: Serial one-request inference; seed 42; reference defaults; no fast packing, compilation, FP8 or new quantization. Repeats shuffled in ten blocks.
evaluation: Compare repeat ranges, option-order max/mean/median review-level gaps, semantic mapping averages, winning-state changes and qualitative case reading. Do not use inherited provisional references for a claimed independent accuracy or calibration score.
